event_payload_scope: Direct EventMsg payload declarations include serde attributes/custom codec annotations. Referenced nested family types remain in companion wire/lifecycle catalogs; arbitrary JSON payload contents are open.

durable_event_producer_coverage.branch_specific_test_limit: Per-entry tests indicate actual coverage level; complete per-branch end-to-end file production testing remains open.

future_record_policy.acceptance: Preserve raw record/payload plus extras for every valid JSON envelope, including future unknown event/record kinds. Semantic projections can be added later without re-normalizing original bytes.
future_record_policy.local_projection_gap: Most known EventMsg variants currently remain raw-only in semantic projections. This catalog documents their saved schemas; it does not claim ingestion projects all fields.

before_policy: Output collection uses bounded head/tail buffers (unified pending/transcript cap 1 MiB); lossy UTF-8 conversion and omitted-byte markers can already modify retained text.

ExecCommandToolOutput model response picks requested token budget versus configured truncation policy, reserves serialization/header bytes, and truncates again until full response fits. Response includes chunk/session/exit/timing/original-token headers.

Completed CommandExecution uses aggregate transcript (fallback when empty), independent of model response formatting; central paginated policy subsequently caps it at 64 KiB. Wait/write_stdin output may be a chunk; terminal completed command uses transcript.
Prepared patch executor returns text wrapped as ApplyPatchToolOutput; conversion preserves text and sets success=true.

FileChange completion stores changes and captured stdout/stderr; legacy conversion projects the same fields. No FileChange-specific byte cap exists in central persistence policy. Captured output may already be bounded upstream.

tests.description: partial changes streaming; filtered updates distinct from durable completion

before_policy: Handler snapshots prepared tool-specific output token limit or model default.

Model-facing response derives FunctionCallOutputPayload, downgrades unsupported original image detail, prefixes wall time, and applies serialization-allowance token/audio-aware truncation before ResponseItem envelope creation.

Completed MCP presentation item uses the result/error plus invocation metadata independently of that model payload; central paginated persistence truncates its result at 64 KiB, while legacy completion policy passes through.
Tool-result metadata capture is separately gated; public/raw result and attached Code Mode metadata should be interpreted through their actual schema rather than assumed universal sanitization.
Host content_items map into FunctionCallOutputContentItem; success is copied.
FunctionToolOutput converts a singleton text body to Text and retains multi-item bodies as ContentItems; this converter adds no generic output truncation.

Common conversation image/audio preparation occurs before durable append. ContextManager separately truncates a cloned processed output for model history; that cloned reduction does not replace the original durable ResponseItem envelope.
Hosted WebSearchCall converts action/query to typed WebSearchItem with results=None and retains raw model response separately.

Standalone extension requests max_output_tokens from call truncation policy; returned output string becomes FunctionCallOutput. Its results are cloned into completed extension item and explicit legacy event.

Standalone error text is character-boundary truncated to MAX_SEARCH_ERROR_BYTES with a marker. SearchOutput converter copies the returned payload; model-context clone truncation remains separate from original durable envelope.
Hosted generation copies status/revised_prompt/result into typed item; saved_path starts None.

Extension generation saves image bytes, uploads with ephemeral/usage context, and records File reference on successful file upload or Inline bytes on inline/failure/decode fallback. Saved path, prompt and input references remain presentation payload fields.
Model-facing output retains original image for common Core image preparation/upload independently of the presentation attachment reference.
